versions.content: Definition of multicast only reception of an EventGroup If a ConsumedEventGroup has aggregated one or several PduActivationRout- ingGroup s in the role pduActivationRoutingGroup and all of these PduActi- vationRoutingGroup s have PduActivationRoutingGroup . eventGroupCon- trolType set to activationMulticast then this ConsumedEventGroup is de- fined to only receive Events via multicast.
